tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mkha' 'gro yang tig gi them byang dpag bsam

ljon shing bzhugs pa lags so/ / them byang dpag bsam ljon shing zhes bya ba/ dpal don yod grub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zab cing rgya che sku lnga lhun gyis grub/ /yon tan phrin las 'dod ster rol pa can/ /rang byung chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas la/ /bdag gzhan dus rnams kun tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /de yi yum chen mkhar chen mtsho rgyal ni/ /rdo rje phag mo sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ /mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas la/ /dus rnams kun tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /zab cing rgya che dkar shog sdong po la/ /gdams khrid snying po shog 'dra'i yal 'dab rgyas/ /yang zab shog ser me tog 'bras bu can/ /mkha' 'gro yang tig dngos grub ljon shing spro/ /de la dbang gi ma bu'i grangs bstan pa/ /sngon 'gro yid ches khungs btsun shes bya'i phyir/ /gter 'byung lo rgyus rin chen sgron me dang*/ /nyams chag sdig sgrib dam tshig skong dang ni/ /dngos grub kun 'byung mkha' 'gro'i brda dbang dang*/ /dngos gzhi dbang bzhi byin rlabs bla ma'i dbang*/ /rgyud la smin grol nus pa 'jug phyir te/ /rig pa'i rtsal dbang snang srid chos skur 'char/ /mkha' 'gro'i don dbang dngos grub chu bo 'grub/ /rdo rje slob dpon gzhan phan phrin las mchog /bstan pa'i srog shing gzug phyir gzhan bka' dang*/ /gtad rgya'i byin rlabs gcig nas gcig tu brgyud/ /bka' bsgos ma sring dam can las la khol/ /de yi cha lag legs par bstan pa yang*/ /rang nyid dbang dang gdams pa dag bya'i phyir/ /bdag 'jug pad+ma klong yangs bzang po dang*/ /lag len bstan phyir tshogs mchod rgya mtsho'i sprin/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs chen gnyis rdzogs ldan/ /de ltar ma dgu bu ni rnam pa drug /rtsa ba'i sde tshan rnam pa bzhir bsdus pas/ /rin chen dbang gi phreng ba legs par tshang*/ /de dag rnams ni zab cing rgya che bas/ /rin chen dkar shog ngos la legs par mnan/

/ bka' yi rgyas btab phyi rabs don du bstan/ /smin cing grol bar byed pa bskyed rdzogs te/ /de yi gdams ngag ma bu'i grangs bstan pa/ /gsang sngags zab mo byin rlabs bla ma'i lam/ /de phyir gsol 'debs dri med zla rgyas dang*/ /bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun rnam pa gnyis su bstan/ /lam la 'jug pa'ang rim pas bslab pa'i phyir/ khrid du bsdebs te nyams su blang ba ni/ / dang po'i babs tshul cig char 'jug pa'i phyir/ /nor bu'i lugs te phreng ba rtsar brgyus 'dra/ /skal ldan skyes bu khrid tshar gcig thob pas/ /mkha' spyod grol phyir nyi zla gza' skar lugs/ /de dag rim pa mi 'gyur gzer gdab phyir/ /zab mo rab 'byed don gyi chings su bstan/ /ji ltar khrid tshul rab tu rgyas pa ni/ /rin chen gser phreng skal ldan snying po'i bcud/ /dbang khrid sngon du tshogs chen rdzogs bya'i phyir/ /rig pa khyad par can gyi tshogs bsags dang*/ /de ltar ma gsum bu ni rnam pa bzhis/ /rim bgrod khrid kyi yi ge tshang bar bstan/ /'di dag yang zab gnad de dkon pas na/ /rin chen shog 'dra'i ngos la legs par btab/ /dbang khrid dag gi rgyab chos bstan pa ni/ /stong pa khrigs chod chos sku lam khyer dang*/ /snang ba thod rgal gzugs sku lam du byed/ /de dag cha rkyen zab don sna tshogs gsum/ /so sor phye nas go rim nges pa'i don/ /dum dang ma bu'i grangs su bstan pa lags/ khregs chod rgyab yig nam mkha' skor gsum las/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams lta ba bya rtsol med/ /nam mkha' klong yangs sgom pa blo las 'das/ /nam mkha' dri med spyod pa blang dor med/ /gdod ma'i ngang du gnyis med la bzla 'o/ /thod rgal rgyab yig 'od gsal gnad bzhi la/ /gser gyi sgrom bus gnad rnams mdor dril zhing*/ /rin chen mdzod kyi dbye ba rgyas par bshad/ rgya mtsho sprin gyis shin tu rgya che ba/ /rnam grangs ma lus yongs su rdzogs par bstan/

/ sa bcud bsdus don nyi ma'i 'od zer yang yod/ de yi bogs 'byin gnad bsdus gces pa'i 'gag /gsang spyod rdo rje lam bstan snying dang 'dra/ /de ltar ma dang bu gnyis sde tshan bdun/ /rin chen shog skyar bkod nas snang bar byas/ /de dag kun gyi snying po'i bcud phyung ba/ /zab mo'i yang zab mkha' 'gro snying gi snying*/ /snying la babs pas snying gi khrag lta bu/ /shin tu yang zab bstan par phangs na yang*/ /mkha' 'gro'i bkas gnang skal ldan snying gi bu/ /phyi rabs 'ga' tsam 'byung zhes lung bstan pas/ /de yi don phyir ma bu'i grangs bstan pa/ /shin tu spros pa med pa'i gang zag rnams/ /smin byed dbang dang grol byed khrid bstan pa/ /nges don snying po rab gsang yi ge dang*/ /rgyal sras bla ma'i dngos grub thob byed pa/ /byin rlabs thugs sgrub shin tu zab mo dang*/ /tshe gcig rig 'dzin lam la gnas byed pa/ /rig 'dzin mchog sgrub rab tu gsang ba dang*/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub myur bsgrub pa/ /mkha' 'gro'i bskyed rim yid bzhin nor bu dang rdzogs rim rlung drug rdo rngo'i chings yang yod / /rlung las 'od gsal skad cig 'grub byed pa/ /rlung sbyor ye shes dra ba dam pa dang*/ khams kyis 'chi med 'od gsal rab 'grub phyir/ /zab lam bde chen rgya mtsho zhes bya dang*/ /gsang ba zab mo'i rdzogs rim mngon byung ba/ ye shes 'od gsal 'khor lo'i rim pa dang*/ /gdod ma'i dbyings kyi rang bzhin bstan pa ni/ /gzhi snang ngo sprod rab tu gsang ba dang*/ /mngon sum snying po'i bcud phyung dril ba ni/ /'od gsal sbubs 'jug snying gi man ngag dang*/ /snang rig ye shes mngon du 'byin byed pa/ /sgron ma bzhi skor mig ltar gsal ba dang*/ /gang yang lam gyur 'od gsal mdor gcig pa/ /'khrul snang gzhi grol rab tu gces pa dang*/ /bag chags nyon mongs myur du 'gog byed pa/ /rmi lam 'od gsal sbubs 'jug gdams pa dang*/

/sems nyid gsang ba'i rang bzhin mngon phyung ba/ /gdod ma'i dbyings snang ngo sprod gsang ba dang*/ /gang dang mi 'dra gnad rnams mthar thug pa/ /zab don gnad kyi ldai mig gsang ba dang*/ / mngon sum don la yid ches ma nor lam/ /'od gsal pra khrid ri chen gsal ba dang*/ /nyin mtshan bar do'i gces pa kun dril ba/ /gsang lam ngo sprod snying po'i mthar thug dang*/ /nor dang 'phyugs med gnad rnams dril ba'i 'gag /zab don snying po man ngag gsang ba dang*/ /dpe don rtags kyi ngo sprod gsal ba'i lam/ /kun 'dus rin chen gsang ba'i ngo sprod dang*/ / shin tu yang zab snying po'i bcud dril ba/ /bar do sbubs 'jug man ngag snying po dang*/ /nyams len gnad kyi gdams pa mthar thug pa/ /bar do gnad kyi sgron me zhes bya dang gnad gsum sgron me yang yod / /zab gter babs lugs ngo mtshar yid ches don/ mthong snang rin chen 'od kyi dra bas bstan/ /phyi rabs don du zab mo'i snying gtam tshul/ /zhal chems dri med 'od kyis legs par gdams zhal chems gnad kyi me long dang mthar thug gcig ma yang yod / /de ltar ma bcu bu ni bcu bzhi yis/ /mkha' 'gro'i gdams pa shog ser snying po tshang*/ / gnad kyi yang gnad mchog tu gsang ba'i gnad/ /ches gsang rmad du byung ba'i snying po 'di/ /gang dang mi 'dra kun gyis mi rtogs pa/ /bla ma mkha' 'gro'i thugs bcud snying po 'di/ /bdag gi snying ste rab tu phangs pas na/ / rin chen shog ser ngos la bkod pa ni/ /bla ma'i bka' rgya mkha' 'gro'i gter rgya dang*/ /bka' srung dam rgya bden pa'i smon lam rgya/ /zab mo'i gnad rgya rgya lngas rgyas btab nas/ /snying dang 'dra ba'i bu mchog skal che ba/ / bla ma la gus shes rab snying brtser ldan/ /sgrub la brtson zhing dam tshig gtsang ba dang*/ tshe 'di blos btang mkha' 'gro'i mtshan rtags can/ /rang dang 'dra ba gcig nas gcig brgyud bya/ /mang por mi spel des kyang gcig la brgyud/

/de yang lo gsum bar du brtags nas sbyin/ /bla ma mkha'a'agros lung bstan ma byung na/ /rdzogs par mi sbyin snying la sa mā ya/ /gnad res kyang ni tshe gcig grol ba'i chos/ /rin chen shog ser kho bo'i snying gi snying*/ phyi rabs skal ldan dam pas gces par zung*/ /'di 'dra'i gdams pa yang gsang snying po'i don/ /lo gsum nyams blangs 'od lus 'grub byed pa/ / 'dzam bu'i gling na dkon pa'i rin po che/ mkha' 'gro'i gsang tshig dam pa yin pas na/ /gcig pur nyams longs sgrub pa mtha' ru skyol/ /rang 'tshengs gzhan 'tshengs thams cad rdzogs sangs rgya/ /de phyir snying bas gces par 'di zung la/ /yang mdzod dmar po'i nang du rgyas thob cig / rigs lnga'i gsang sgrub pad+ma stong ldan la/ /phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang rnam bzhis tshang/ /de yis gtso bor rang bzhin sprul sku 'grub/ /rigs lnga'i bcud len bdud rtsi'i thigs pa la/ /snying po lnga dang gces pa'i gnad lnga ste/ /yang zab chig dril legs par bstan pa ni/ /sa yi bcud len bdud rtsi yang zhun dang*/ /chu yi bcud len bde chen rgya mtsho dang*/ /me yi bcud len bde drod rang 'bar dang*/ /rlung gi bcud len dpag bsam ljon shing dang*/ /nam mkha'i bcud len ye shes gsang 'khor te/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub myur du 'grub/ /gegs sel nad 'don bdud rtsi sprin phung la/ /'khor lo lnga yis phyi nang bar chad sel/ /'chi ba brtags bslu nyi zla gza' bral la/ /dum bu gnyis kyis rnal 'byor don chen 'grub/ /btags grol man ngag rin chen snying po yis/ /de nyid don shes rang gzhan phan pa 'grub/ /bcu drug phran bu ma bzhi sde tshan lngar/ /rin chen shog 'dra'i ngos la bkod pa yin/ /de dag rnams kyi cha rkyen yan lag tu/ /rgyud gzhan dag la bltos pa med pa'i phyir/ /gzhan don phrin las sgrub pa'i rim pa yang*/ / sreg sbyong cho ga 'od kyi snye ma yis/

/tshe 'das sku gdung ji ltar bzhu ba bstan/ /gzhan phan 'od kyi 'khor lo bzang po yis/ /bar do'i 'gro ba rnams la phan gdags bshad/ /de yi gnad yig phyag rgya bzhi mchod kyis/ / lag len gnad yig ma tshang kha skong bstan/ /mchod rten rab gnas rin chen drwa ba yis/ /tshwa tshwa'i sgo nas tshogs bsag sgrib sbyong bstan/ /rab gnas cho ga ye shes dri med kyis/ /sku gsung thugs rten rab tu gnas pa bshad/ / mthong snang gser gyi dra ba mig lta bus/ /nyams rtogs gnad dang chos kyi babs tshul la/ /ngo mtshar yid ches rmad byung bskyed pa bstan/ /de ltar ma gsum bu gsum sde tshan drug /rin chen dkar shog bzang po'i ngos la mnan/ /phyi rabs skal ldan dam pa'i rigs can rnams/ /rang gzhan don du spyod cig sa ma ya/ /de ltar zab chos snying po'i bstan pa 'di/ / mi nub bsrung phyir drag sngags mtshon cha yang*/ /bka' bsrung sgrub sde so so'i rgyud gzhung las/ /yang zab gnad rnams btus te bstan pa ni/ /slob dpon gsang yum rdo rje g.yu sgron mas/ /rnal 'byor bsam pa yid bzhin bsgrubs pas na/ /de yi sgrub thabs zla ba 'dod 'jo la/ /phyi nang gsang gsum mchog tu zab pa'i gnad/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyal po 'dra ba bshad/ / 'jig rten khams na rdzu 'phrul mthu rtsal can/ /kun gyi mchog gyur drang srong chen po ste/ /snying nye bkra shis dngos su mthu rtsal 'byung*/ /de phyir de 'dra kun las 'phags pas na/ /slob dpon chen po'i bka' bsrung gtso bo yin/ /de yi gsang sgrub dug gi spu gri bstan/ khyad par gza' bdud khyab mjug mig dmar ni/ /sngon byung slob dpon mched yin drag rtsal can/ / snang srid sil bur gtong ba'i mthu mnga' ba/ /chos 'di'i bka' bsrung gnyen po gsang ba ste/ /de yi sgrub thabs me rlung 'khyil pa bstan/ /kun dang mi 'dra gsang ba'i ma mo ni/ /kun tu bzang mo'i thugs kyi sprul pa ste/

/e ka tsa ti khros pa'i rnam 'phrul mchog /srog sgrub nag mo shan pa mi bsrun ma/ / chos 'dis phyir na lus dang grib ma bzhin/ /'bral ba med pa rgyun du bsrungs bas na/ kun bzang mkha' 'gro ma mo nyid sprul nas/ /zab chos skyong mdzad gter srung mnga' gsol ba/ /slob pon chen pos bka' bsgos bzhag pa'i phyir/ /mchog tu gnyan zhing sgrub pa po la brtse/ /de phyir de yi sgrub thabs gsang ba ni/ /dug mda' nag po zhes bya rab tu bkod/ /'di dag rnams ni 'jigs pa'i gnam lcags 'dra/ /dam tshig ldan la sgrub thag shin tu nye/ /chos 'di'i yi ge gang yod 'di gnas pas/ /ma bsgrubs kyang ni rtag tu srung skyob byed/ /de phyir mchod gtor rgyun du bya ba gces/ khyad par dus gnyan bskang gso mchod par bya/ /tshe dang nor phyug snyan grags skye bo 'du/ /gegs rnams med cing bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub/ /phran gsum bu ste ma bzhi sde tshan bzhi/ /rin chen shog 'dra'i ngos la legs par bkod/ / de ltar yang zab chos kyi rnam grangs kun/ /yongs su dril ba'i chings kyi gal mdo la/ /rin chen dkar shog ma bu bcu dgu yang*/ /rtsa ba'i sde tshan bcu bdun dag tu bsdus/ /rin chen shog 'dra ma bu sum cu yang*/ /rtsa ba'i sde tshan bcu drug dag tu bsdus/ /rin chen shog ser ma bcu bu bcu gsum/ /so sor dbye na nyi shu rtsa gsum mo/ /them byang gnyis dang bsdams pas bdun cu gsum/ /mkha' 'gro yang tig gsang ba'i debs su bstan/ /phyi rabs snying gi bu gcig ma gtogs pa/ /gzhan la mi bstan mkha' 'gro'i bka' rgya yod/ /e ma ho/ rang byung sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /bod yul dbus su zab gter sbas pa la/ /lho ru bskyed rdzogs 'dril ba sdong po'i skor/ / nub tu gsal ba me tog kha bye 'dra/ /byang du rgyas pa yal 'dab chen po la/ / shar du legs smin 'bras bu bcud du dril/ /dbus su zug pa rtsa ba'i skor lnga las/

/'di ni mthar thug 'bras bu'i gter kha ste/ /dgongs gter snying po snying tig mngon sum lam/ tshe gcig 'bras bu 'od lus 'grub par byed/ /de phyir 'di 'dra'i zab gter gzhan na med/ /deng song tshe lo lnga bcu kha ral dus/ /snga ma'i tshe la dngas lung brag ngos nas/ chu mo glang lor shog ser sgo phye ste/ /rjod byed tshig gi cha tsam dbang bar byas/ /deng song thod rgal longs sku'i zhing nyul dus/ /shing mo yos la mchims phur dgongs gter babs/ /brjod bya'i don rnams ma lus snying la shar/ /bla ma mkha' 'gros dngos su byin brlabs pas/ /tshig don 'dres med gsang ba'i yi ge rnams/ /rgyal sras bla ma nyid dang mtshungs pas na/ /yi ge 'di rnams gces pas snying la phur/ /dge ba 'di yis ma lus 'gro ba kun/ /tshe gcig 'od lus dam pa rab 'grub nas/ /phyam gcig rang bzhin gdod ma'i sar grol te/ / rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub par shog /mkha' 'gro yang tig gi them byang dpag bsam ljong shing zhes bya ba/ /rang byung pad+mas dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnal 'byor pa dri med 'od zer gyis/ gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul du bkod pa rdzogs so/ /them byang gnyis las/ 'di ni mthar thug gi bu la sbyin pa'o/ /de'ang snod phal pa la dang po na yod pa bzhin shog ser rnams las sde tshan bdun ma gtogs pa/ thams cad yongs su rdzogs par mi sbyin te bka' rgya yod/ rab mchog snying gi bu gcig la 'di na yod pa thams cad/ them byang 'di rdzogs par sbyin/ yi ge 'di'i nang na yod pa'i chos skor rnams la 'dra min dang bcos bslad byed pa byung na/ dam tshig gi chad pas dmyal bar lhung zhing*/ bka' srung gis srog dang phrol cig/gza' rā hu la/ gnod sbyin dmar nag/rdo rje g.yul sgron/ srog sgrub nag mo rnams la gtad pas/ thub par srung shig sa ma ya/ bkra shis/
